summary: Adds non-required, report-only CI jobs comparing Fractal evidence lane decisions with mergemaster's pinned copy; no runtime, user-visible or upgrade impact.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of runtime state.

schema.detail: No database or storage version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, authoritative evidence decisions or required checks change.

compatibility.detail: CI-only reporting; no runtime, wire, client or stored-format change.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes CI reports only; no runtime state to recover.
